name: Snail Agent Flow Qualitative Evaluation Rubric

criteria.name: Specification Completeness
criteria.description: Checks if the feature specification includes comprehensive user stories, edge cases, functional requirements, and success criteria without using forbidden placeholder terms.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan Feasibility
criteria.description: Checks if the plan proposed is technically sound, minimally invasive, identifies exact code changes, and defines a clear testable verification strategy.

criteria.name: Architectural Compliance
criteria.description: Checks if the proposed changes respect directory boundaries, path ownership rules, and keep external integrations (such as databases or third-party APIs) optional and modular.

criteria.name: Verification Parity
criteria.description: Checks if the verification steps outlined in the spec match the test execution logs and automated CI matrix configurations.
